what: Collect CRAN health, version and download data — collect_cran
title: Collect CRAN health, version and download data — collect_cran
text: Collects four CRAN-side tables packages curated config/repos.yml, writes one Parquet file staging_dir consolidate() upsert: cran_downloads – daily download counts Posit mirror (cranlogs.r-pkg.org). Retroactive, /apply . cran_versions – full published version history release dates crandb.r-pkg.org/{pkg}/. cran_checks – R CMD check status per flavour, read CRAN's official .rds artifact via tools::CRAN_check_results(). cran_status – presence CRAN, archival state, maintainer worst check status across flavours. four collected independently: failure one recorded run manifest prevent others written. Every network call retries three times exponential backoff 5xx/timeout honours Retry-429.

what: Consolidate staged collections into the canonical Parquet store — consolidate
title: Consolidate staged collections into the canonical Parquet store — consolidate
text: single write path canonical data store (consolidate job). one call, order: Upsert every table found staging_dir data_dir, natural key. Last-write-wins everywhere except gh_traffic, merges max() per key. Roll table calendar months data_dir/archive/<table>_monthly.parquet. Prune table rolling 12-month window – , tables whose rollup succeeded call. Record one run_manifest row per source processed, sanitised, truncated message.

code: consolidate(   staging_dir = "staging",   data_dir = "data",   archive_dir = file.path(data_dir, "archive"),   retention_months = 12L,   reference_date = Sys.Date(),   run_ts = Sys.time() )

title: Consolidate staged collections into the canonical Parquet store — consolidate
text: Missing input error. staging table absent simply means collector run (failed) execution; corresponding canonical table left untouched remaining tables still consolidated. absent data_dir created, absent canonical table treated empty table. function therefore safe call completely empty checkout. Idempotence. Running twice staging input produces canonical tables row counts: upsert key, rollup upserts monthly aggregate, prune function data reference date . Retention gate. prune merely ordered rollup; conditional . gh_traffic irrecoverable – GitHub API retains 14 days – rollup throws, daily rows surviving copy period kept. outcome per table returned, tests/testthat/test-retention-order.R asserts .

title: Export the canonical Parquet store as JSON for the static dashboard — export_json
text: absent Parquet file empty table, error, every array output emitted even empty. Calling directory data produces ten valid, empty--well-formed JSON files, lets site build first collection run. code: # Works on an empty store: every file is written, every array is empty. tmp <- tempfile() dir.create(tmp) out <- export_json(   data_dir = file.path(tmp, "data"),   output_dir = file.path(tmp, "json") ) #>  #> ── export_json() ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ℹ data /tmp/RtmpTuom5d/file449bd98190d/data -> json /tmp/RtmpTuom5d/file449bd98190d/json. #> ✔ 10 JSON files written (1603 bytes). out$file #>  [1] "overview.json"       "cran_status.json"    "cran_downloads.json" #>  [4] "gh_activity.json"    "gh_traffic.json"     "gh_issues.json"      #>  [7] "gh_releases.json"    "academic.json"       "freshness.json"      #> [10] "meta.json"           jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(tmp, "json", "meta.json"))$schema_version #> [1] 1  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # In the pipeline, against the checked-out `data` branch. export_json(data_dir = "data", output_dir = "site/_data") } # }
